corn_gray_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin or Propiconazole fungicide at onset. Ensure crop rotation and avoid overhead irrigation.
corn_gray_leaf_spot.telangana_relevance: Common during Kharif season in humid conditions. Watch during August-September.
corn_gray_leaf_spot.logic_rule_text: If corn_gray_leaf_spot THEN (Gray/Tan Lesions AND High Humidity AND Prolonged Leaf Wetness)

corn_leaf_blight.treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75WP at 2.5g/L. Remove infected debris. Use resistant hybrids.
corn_leaf_blight.telangana_relevance: Northern Leaf Blight is prevalent in Telangana's maize-growing districts.
corn_leaf_blight.logic_rule_text: If corn_leaf_blight THEN (Tan/Water-Soaked Lesions AND Moderate-High Humidity)

corn_rust_leaf.treatment: Apply Propiconazole or Tebuconazole at first sign. Scout regularly during cool humid periods.
corn_rust_leaf.telangana_relevance: Polysora rust is more common in Telangana than common rust due to warmer temperatures.
corn_rust_leaf.logic_rule_text: If corn_rust_leaf THEN (Orange Pustules AND Moderate Humidity AND Cool Temperatures)

pepper_bell_bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply Copper Oxychloride 50WP at 3g/L. Avoid overhead irrigation. Use certified disease-free seeds.
pepper_bell_bacterial_spot.telangana_relevance: Bacterial spot caused by Xanthomonas vesicatoria. Common in Telangana chilli-growing areas.
pepper_bell_bacterial_spot.logic_rule_text: If pepper_bell_bacterial_spot THEN (Water-Soaked Spots AND Yellow Halos AND High Humidity AND Leaf Wetness)

pepper_bell_healthy.treatment: No treatment required. Maintain balanced nutrition and regular scouting.
pepper_bell_healthy.telangana_relevance: Healthy pepper leaf. Continue current cultivation practices.
pepper_bell_healthy.logic_rule_text: If pepper_bell_healthy THEN (Uniform Green Tissue AND No Disease Signs)

potato_early_blight.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb at 7-10 day intervals. Ensure adequate potassium nutrition.
potato_early_blight.telangana_relevance: Alternaria solani. Common in Mahabubnagar and Nizamabad potato growing regions.
potato_early_blight.logic_rule_text: If potato_early_blight THEN (Concentric Rings AND Brown Spots AND Moderate Humidity AND Warm Temperatures)

potato_healthy.treatment: No treatment required. Monitor for early signs of late blight in humid conditions.
potato_healthy.telangana_relevance: Healthy potato leaf. Continue current cultivation practices.
potato_healthy.logic_rule_text: If potato_healthy THEN (Dark Green Tissue AND No Disease Signs)

potato_late_blight.treatment: URGENT: Apply Metalaxyl+Mancozeb immediately. Destroy infected plants. Avoid overhead irrigation.
potato_late_blight.telangana_relevance: Phytophthora infestans. Can cause total crop loss within days. High risk in cool rainy periods.
potato_late_blight.logic_rule_text: If potato_late_blight THEN (Water-Soaked Spots AND White Mold AND Very High Humidity AND Cool Temps AND Leaf Wetness)

rice_bacterial_leaf_blight.treatment: No effective chemical cure. Remove infected plants. Use resistant varieties like IR64. Avoid excess nitrogen.
rice_bacterial_leaf_blight.telangana_relevance: Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae. Major threat in Godavari delta and Warangal. Spreads through flood water.
rice_bacterial_leaf_blight.logic_rule_text: If rice_bacterial_leaf_blight THEN (Water-Soaked Margins AND Yellow Lesions AND Milky Ooze AND High Humidity)

rice_brown_spot.treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25EC at 1ml/L or Tricyclazole 75WP at 0.6g/L. Ensure silicon and potassium nutrition.
rice_brown_spot.telangana_relevance: Bipolaris oryzae. Common in nutrient-deficient soils in Telangana. Associated with food security concern Tungro.
rice_brown_spot.logic_rule_text: If rice_brown_spot THEN (Oval Brown Spots AND Yellow Halos AND Moderate Humidity)

rice_healthy.treatment: No treatment required. Maintain water management and balanced NPK nutrition.
rice_healthy.telangana_relevance: Healthy rice leaf. Continue current cultivation practices. Scout regularly during humid periods.
rice_healthy.logic_rule_text: If rice_healthy THEN (Bright Green Tissue AND No Disease Signs)

rice_leaf_blast.treatment: Apply Tricyclazole 75WP at 0.6g/L or Isoprothiolane 40EC at 1.5ml/L. Avoid excess nitrogen.
rice_leaf_blast.telangana_relevance: Pyricularia oryzae. Most damaging rice disease in Telangana. Critical during tillering stage.
rice_leaf_blast.logic_rule_text: If rice_leaf_blast THEN (Diamond-Shaped Lesions AND Gray Centers AND High Humidity AND Moderate Temperatures)

rice_leaf_scald.treatment: Apply Propiconazole or Hexaconazole. Avoid high nitrogen application. Improve drainage.
rice_leaf_scald.telangana_relevance: Monographella albescens. Less common but increasing in Telangana rice fields.
rice_leaf_scald.logic_rule_text: If rice_leaf_scald THEN (Brown Zonate Bands AND High Humidity AND High Temperature)

rice_sheath_blight.treatment: Apply Hexaconazole 5EC at 2ml/L or Propiconazole 25EC at 1ml/L. Reduce planting density.
rice_sheath_blight.telangana_relevance: Rhizoctonia solani. Second most destructive rice disease in Telangana after blast.
rice_sheath_blight.logic_rule_text: If rice_sheath_blight THEN (Oval Sheath Lesions AND Gray Centers AND High Humidity AND Dense Canopy)

tomato_bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply Copper Hydroxide 77WP at 3g/L. Avoid overhead irrigation. Use disease-free transplants.
tomato_bacterial_spot.telangana_relevance: Xanthomonas vesicatoria. Common in Ranga Reddy and Medak tomato growing areas.
tomato_bacterial_spot.logic_rule_text: If tomato_bacterial_spot THEN (Angular Water-Soaked Lesions AND Yellowing AND High Humidity)

tomato_early_blight.treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75WP at 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil at 3ml/L every 7-10 days.
tomato_early_blight.telangana_relevance: Alternaria solani. Very common in Telangana's tomato-growing areas during Kharif.
tomato_early_blight.logic_rule_text: If tomato_early_blight THEN (Concentric Brown Rings AND Target Pattern AND Moderate Humidity)

tomato_healthy.treatment: No treatment required. Maintain balanced NPK nutrition. Scout weekly.
tomato_healthy.telangana_relevance: Healthy tomato leaf. Continue current cultivation practices.
tomato_healthy.logic_rule_text: If tomato_healthy THEN (Dark Green Tissue AND No Disease Signs)

tomato_late_blight.treatment: URGENT: Apply Metalaxyl+Mancozeb at 3g/L. Destroy infected material. Avoid irrigation at night.
tomato_late_blight.telangana_relevance: Phytophthora infestans. Can destroy crop within 5-7 days. High risk in rainy cool nights.
tomato_late_blight.logic_rule_text: If tomato_late_blight THEN (Water-Soaked Lesions AND White Mold AND Very High Humidity AND Cool Temperatures)

tomato_leaf_mold.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb. Improve ventilation in greenhouses. Avoid excessive nitrogen.
tomato_leaf_mold.telangana_relevance: Passalora fulva. Common in protected cultivation/greenhouses in Telangana.
tomato_leaf_mold.logic_rule_text: If tomato_leaf_mold THEN (Yellow Patches AND Olive Mold On Underside AND High Humidity)

tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants immediately. Control aphid vectors with Imidacloprid. Use virus-free seeds.
tomato_mosaic_virus.telangana_relevance: Tobacco Mosaic Virus spread by contact and tools. Common in intensive tomato cultivation.
tomato_mosaic_virus.logic_rule_text: If tomato_mosaic_virus THEN (Mosaic Discoloration AND Leaf Distortion â€” spread by contact, not humidity)

tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil 75WP at 3g/L or Mancozeb. Remove lower infected leaves. Avoid wetting foliage.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.telangana_relevance: Septoria lycopersici. Starts on lower leaves and progresses upward. Common during rainy season.
tomato_septoria_leaf_spot.logic_rule_text: If tomato_septoria_leaf_spot THEN (Small Circular Spots AND White Centers AND Dark Borders AND Leaf Wetness)

tomato_spider_mites_two_spotted_spider_m.treatment: Apply Abamectin or Spiromesifen miticide. Increase humidity by irrigation. Avoid dusty conditions.
tomato_spider_mites_two_spotted_spider_m.telangana_relevance: Tetranychus urticae. Severe during hot dry summers in Telangana. Not a fungal disease.
tomato_spider_mites_two_spotted_spider_m.logic_rule_text: If tomato_spider_mites THEN (Fine Webbing AND Stippling AND Low Humidity AND High Temperatures â€” NOT fungal)

tomato_target_spot.treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin or Chlorothalonil. Maintain proper plant spacing for air circulation.
tomato_target_spot.telangana_relevance: Corynespora cassiicola. Emerging disease in Telangana's tomato growing areas.
tomato_target_spot.logic_rule_text: If tomato_target_spot THEN (Concentric Ring Lesions AND Halos AND High Humidity AND Warm Temperatures)

tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus.treatment: No cure. Control whitefly vector with Imidacloprid or Thiamethoxam. Use TYLCV-resistant varieties. Remove infected plants.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus.telangana_relevance: TYLCV is one of the most damaging tomato viruses in Telangana. Spread by Bemisia tabaci whiteflies.
tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus.logic_rule_text: If tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus THEN (Upward Leaf Curl AND Yellowing AND Small Leaves â€” spread by whitefly vectors)

cotton_bacterial_blight.telangana_relevance: Direct Evidence: High temperatures and monsoon humidity in Telangana favor Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum.
cotton_bacterial_blight.treatment: Apply Copper oxychloride or Streptomycin sulfate. Use resistant varieties.
cotton_bacterial_blight.logic_rule_text: If cotton_bacterial_blight THEN (Angular spots AND High Humidity AND High Temps)

cotton_grey_mildew.telangana_relevance: Direct Evidence: Common in central and southern regions during cool, humid periods.
cotton_grey_mildew.treatment: Apply Carbendazim or Wettable sulfur. Ensure proper spacing for aeration.
cotton_grey_mildew.logic_rule_text: If cotton_grey_mildew THEN (Grey powdery growth AND Moderate temps AND High humidity)

cotton_leaf_curl_virus.telangana_relevance: Indirect Agronomic Context: Spread by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci) which thrive in warm, dry spells.
cotton_leaf_curl_virus.treatment: No cure. Control whitefly vectors with Imidacloprid. Uproot infected plants.
cotton_leaf_curl_virus.logic_rule_text: If cotton_leaf_curl_virus THEN (Leaf curl AND vein thickening -- virus vector)

cotton_healthy.telangana_relevance: Healthy cotton leaf. Monitor for pests and diseases regularly.

groundnut_early_leaf_spot.telangana_relevance: Direct Evidence: Common in Kharif season across Telangana groundnut belts.
groundnut_early_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb. Implement crop rotation.
groundnut_early_leaf_spot.logic_rule_text: If early_leaf_spot THEN (Brown spots with yellow halos AND High humidity)

groundnut_late_leaf_spot.telangana_relevance: Direct Evidence: Often co-occurs with rust late in the season.
groundnut_late_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply Tebuconazole or Hexaconazole. Avoid continuous groundnut cultivation.
groundnut_late_leaf_spot.logic_rule_text: If late_leaf_spot THEN (Dark spots mostly underneath AND High humidity)

groundnut_rust.telangana_relevance: Direct Evidence: Major yield reducer in Telangana when combined with late leaf spot.
groundnut_rust.logic_rule_text: If rust THEN (Orange pustules AND High humidity AND Cool temps)

chilli_leaf_curl.telangana_relevance: Indirect Agronomic Context: Spread by thrips/mites. Thrives in dry, warm conditions common in Khammam/Warangal.
chilli_leaf_curl.treatment: Control vectors (thrips/mites) using Spinosad or Abamectin. Destroy infected plants.
chilli_leaf_curl.logic_rule_text: If chilli_leaf_curl THEN (Curled leaves AND vector presence)

chilli_leaf_spot.telangana_relevance: Direct Evidence: Fungal pathogen (Cercospora) favors high humidity.
chilli_leaf_spot.logic_rule_text: If leaf_spot THEN (Circular spots with grey centers AND High humidity)

chilli_whitefly.telangana_relevance: Indirect Agronomic Context: Major vector for leaf curl viruses in Telangana.
chilli_whitefly.treatment: Apply Neem oil or systemic insecticides like Imidacloprid.
chilli_whitefly.logic_rule_text: If whitefly THEN (Visible whiteflies AND warm weather)

chilli_yellowish.telangana_relevance: Indirect Agronomic Context: Often indicates nutrient deficiency, waterlogging, or early viral infection.
chilli_yellowish.treatment: Check soil moisture (avoid waterlogging) and apply micronutrients (Zinc/Iron).
chilli_yellowish.logic_rule_text: If yellowish THEN (Yellowing leaves AND potential stress factors)
